examples.question: What is the name and marketing segment of the customer with the total order price of 199180.63?
examples.sql: SELECT T2.c_name, T2.c_mktsegment FROM orders AS T1 INNER JOIN customer AS T2 ON T1.o_custkey = T2.c_custkey WHERE T1.o_totalprice = 199180.63

examples.question: Among the male customers with an level of education of 4 and below, list their income K.
examples.sql: SELECT INCOME_K FROM Demog WHERE GEOID IN ( SELECT GEOID FROM Customers WHERE EDUCATIONNUM < 4 AND SEX = 'Male' )
examples.evidence: male customers with an level of education of 4 and below refer to SEX = 'Male' where EDUCATIONNUM < 4;

examples.question: To the products which could make the profit as 21.9037, what were their list price after October of 2012?
examples.sql: SELECT T1.ListPrice FROM Product AS T1 INNER JOIN ProductListPriceHistory AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T1.ListPrice - T1.StandardCost > 21.9037 AND STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T2.StartDate) >= '2012-10-01'
examples.evidence: Profit as 82.41 = SUTRACT(ListPrice, StandardCost); May of 2012 refers to StartDate = '2012-05'
